faqs.q: Do I need a panel upgrade for an EV charger?
faqs.a: Not always. Many homes with a 200-amp panel have room for a Level 2 charger. We check your panel's load first and tell you plainly if it needs an upgrade.

faqs.q: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
faqs.a: Usually too much on one circuit, a worn-out breaker, or a short in an outlet or appliance. The breaker is doing its job, so don't keep resetting it. Call us and we'll find the cause.
A loose bulb or a dimmer that doesn't match the bulb is common. If lights flicker in several rooms, or when a big appliance kicks on, have it checked soon.

faqs.q: Can you add recessed lights without tearing up my ceiling?
faqs.a: Yes, in most homes. We use remodel cans and small access holes, then patch what we touch.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for electrical work?
faqs.a: Most panel upgrades, EV chargers, new circuits, and rewiring need a permit from your city. We pull it and set up the inspection.

faqs.q: What size generator do I need?
faqs.a: It depends on what you want to keep running. A portable generator with a transfer switch can cover the fridge, lights, and Wi-Fi. A standby generator can run the whole house. We'll walk you through both.
Yes. Licensed electricians do the work, and we're fully insured, so you're covered if anything goes wrong.
Tracy, Mountain House, Manteca, Lathrop, Livermore, and Stockton. Just outside? Call us. If we can get there fast, we'll come.
